title: Justin Cormack - When Tests Lie: Using Observability to Keep AI Honest - AI Native DevCon June 2026
description:
Building with tests can only take you so far before things unravel. Observability fills the gap to ensure correctness and security in your codebase. It validates the unseen mechanics behind customer-facing interfaces. It sounds difficult. It's essential. 

Justin Cormack takes us through his journey of creating an AWS S3-compatible storage system with AI. Known for his deep expertise in infrastructure software, Justin brings insights into how observability guides the construction of complex systems, mitigating chaos as projects scale.

What we cover:
• How does observation complement traditional testing in AI-driven projects?
• Justin Cormack's experience building an AWS S3 clone
• The role of AI in large-scale software development
• Testing strategies for complex, distributed systems
• The significance of having a reliable test oracle
